name: refine-frame

frames.best_why: Photo is fully sharp with a tick and 'Ready', the finished state the frame exists to reach.

tagline: An image sharpens from blocky pixels to detail as its generation progresses.
summary: A rounded image frame that moves through queued, generating, refining and ready states, resolving a low-resolution mosaic into the sharp photo without shifting layout.
appearance: A rounded rectangle holding a landscape photo, with a small translucent pill in the bottom-left corner showing a spinner icon and a status word. Above it sits a quoted prompt line in grey, below a small outlined Regenerate button.
behaviour: When the status changes the picture steps from a coarse pixel mosaic toward full sharpness under a moving sheen while the corner chip swaps icons and labels. At ready the chip shows a tick and then fades out.
demo_content: Prompt 'Alpine lake at dawn, mist over the water, soft film grain' with a mountain photo.
search_phrases: image loading placeholder for ai generator
picture fading in from pixelated blur
generation status overlay on a photo
media frame with queued and ready chips
photo that sharpens when it is ready
use_when: An AI image tool needs one result frame that shows queued, generating and ready without layout shift.
avoid_when: It only styles your child image and a chip; real job status and polling must come from your own code.
customise: Status, aspect ratio, width, radius, background and text colour are props, as are stage duration, sweep, labels and retry; the child image is yours.
weight_why: A stack of downscaled canvas copies is rebuilt on resize and drawn per frame while active.

a11y.note: Role, busy state and status text are announced, but the retry button has no visible focus ring.

issues: The frame's role='img' hides the child photo's alt text from screen readers.
polish_why: The mosaic-to-sharp resolve is convincing and layout stays put; small chips stay unobtrusive.
